author: CNN
description:
Cave divers are squeezing through narrow, flooded corridors in a delicate operation to reach seven villagers trapped underground in a cave in Laos for nearly a week. 

The villagers went into the cave in the central Laotian province of Xaisomboun last Wednesday in search of gold, but heavy rain triggered flash flooding which blocked the exit, the Associated Press reported, citing Laos and Thai rescue teams. 

CNN’s Mike Valerio has more, and technical dive instructor Mikko Paasi shares what he experienced during his rescue attempt in the cave. 

0:00 Video shows rescue crews working through narrow cave openings during rescue attempt 
2:36 Rescuer describes the difference between this operation and the 2018 cave rescue in Thailand 
5:26 What are the conditions like for the villagers trapped in the cave? 
7:11 Have the rescuers seen signs of life? 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Laos #CaveRescue #News
title: Laos cave rescue: Divers race to reach 7 trapped in flooded cave

author: CNN
description:
The EU has introduced the “entry/exit system” (EES) across Europe, an automated system to track when foreigners enter and exit countries, replacing stamping passports. While introduced to make traveling easier, CNN's Clarissa Ward shows the reality as passengers are waiting hours in lines and missing their flights.

An earlier version of this video misstated which passport holders are experiencing long lines and delays due to new EES rules. It is non-European Union passport holders.
title: EU’s Entry Exit system causing travel chaos

description:
The US military conducted “self-defense strikes” targeting Iranian missile launch sites and boats around the Strait of Hormuz amid a ceasefire between the two countries and ongoing negotiations to end the war, according to US Central Command. 

“U.S. forces conducted self-defense strikes in southern Iran today to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces,” CENTCOM spokesman Timothy Hawkins told CNN in a statement when asked about explosions reported around the Strait of Hormuz. 

CNN’s Salma Abdelaziz has the details, and CNN global affairs analysts Sabrina Singh and Kim Dozier weigh in on the impact the new strikes could have on the peace negotiations.

title: US strikes southern Iran claiming self defense
